joshua.6.p1.b1.text: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

joshua.6.p1.b2.text: “Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its mighty men of valor.

joshua.6.p1.b3.text: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark. Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the horns.

joshua.6.p1.b4.text: … have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse and all your people will charge straight into the city.”

joshua.6.p2.b1.text: “Take up the ark of the covenant and have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.”

joshua.6.p2.b2.text: While the horns continued to sound, the armed troops marched ahead of the priests who blew the horns, and the rear guard followed the ark.

joshua.6.p2.b3.text: “Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard; do not let one word come out of your mouth …

joshua.6.p2.b4.text: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.

joshua.6.p3.b1.text: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests took the ark of the LORD.

joshua.6.p3.b2.text: And the seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns kept marching ahead of the ark of the LORD and blowing the horns …

joshua.6.p3.b3.text: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

joshua.6.p4.b1.text: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner …

joshua.6.p4.b2.text: … Only Rahab the prostitute and all those with her in her house will live, because she hid the spies we sent.

joshua.6.p4.b3.text: “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

joshua.6.p4.b4.text: But keep away from the things devoted to destruction … For all the silver and gold and all the articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD …

joshua.6.p5.b1.text: So when the rams’ horns sounded, the people shouted. When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed …

joshua.6.p5.b2.text: … Then all the people charged straight into the city and captured it.

joshua.6.p6.b1.text: At the edge of the sword they devoted to destruction everything in the city—man and woman, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.

joshua.6.p6.b2.text: “Go into the house of the prostitute and bring out the woman and all who are with her, just as you promised her.”

joshua.6.p7.b1.text: So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers, and all who belonged to her …

joshua.6.p7.b2.text: … and settled them outside the camp of Israel.

joshua.6.p8.b1.text: Then the Israelites burned up the city and everything in it. However, they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.

joshua.6.p8.b2.text: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her …

joshua.6.p8.b3.text: … So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.

joshua.6.p9.b1.text: “Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho;

joshua.6.p9.b2.text: at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”

joshua.6.p9.b3.text: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
